title: Java Full Stack Engineer – Java EE, Spring, Hibernate & RESTful Web Services
description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking a Java Fullstack Developer to develop, maintain, and enhance Java-based applications and systems. The role focuses on delivering clean, maintainable, scalable, and reliable software solutions using Java, Java EE, web development frameworks, relational databases, SQL, and RESTful web services.
  
  
The Java Fullstack Developer will collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle, contribute to Agile delivery practices, participate in code reviews, and resolve technical issues. The role supports business objectives by delivering quality software, improving application functionality, and maintaining reliable and sustainable technology solutions.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* Java: Strong programming experience in Java, including object-oriented programming and enterprise application development.
* Java EE: Strong knowledge of the Java EE platform and its application in Java-based systems.
* Spring, Hibernate, or JSF: Experience with one or more Java web development frameworks.
* Relational databases and SQL: Practical experience writing SQL queries and integrating Java applications with relational databases.
* RESTful web services: Experience developing, consuming, or integrating RESTful services.
* Git or equivalent version control system: Experience with source-code management, branching, merging, and code collaboration.
* Agile development practices: Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and iterative delivery.
* Software versions: Experience working with the Java, Java EE, framework, database, REST, and version-control tool versions used by the assigned Synechron project. Candidates should be able to understand compatibility, support, and upgrade considerations.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* Experience with multiple Java web development frameworks, including Spring, Hibernate, or JSF.
* Experience with frontend integration, web application components, and full-stack development practices.
* Familiarity with automated testing, build, deployment, code-quality, and continuous integration tools.
* Experience with API documentation, application logging, monitoring, and performance-analysis tools.
* Exposure to cloud-based application development or deployment environments.
* Familiarity with responsive design, accessibility, and web application performance practices.

Equivalent tools and technologies may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities.
  
  
****Overall Responsibilities****

* Develop and maintain Java-based applications and systems.
* Apply strong programming practices to produce clean, maintainable, scalable, and testable code.
* Use Java and Java EE technologies to implement application functionality.
* Develop, integrate, and maintain RESTful web services.
* Work with Spring, Hibernate, JSF, or other approved Java web development frameworks as required by the assigned project.
* Design and implement database interactions using relational databases and SQL.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop new features and improve existing functionality.
* Participate in requirements discussions, technical design activities, sprint planning, reviews, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Participate in code reviews and ensure that code adheres to applicable industry, security, testing, and quality standards.
* Debug and fix application, integration, database, and performance-related technical issues in a timely manner.
* Create and maintain technical documentation for application components, interfaces, configurations, and support procedures.
* Use Git or an equivalent version control system to manage source code and support collaborative development.
* Identify opportunities to improve application performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and usability.
* Stay up to date with the latest developments in Java and related technologies.
* Support sustainable software practices by improving application efficiency, reusing maintainable components, and considering long-term supportability.
* Deliver software increments that meet agreed functional requirements, quality standards, security expectations, and timelines.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Strong programming skills in Java.
* Experience with object-oriented programming principles.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, scalable, and testable code.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data retrieval, manipulation, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to understand and implement application logic across relevant backend and web application layers.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with modern Java language features relevant to the assigned project.
* Experience with scripting or other programming languages used for automation, testing, or application support.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
* Experience designing and executing SQL queries.
* Understanding of tables, relationships, indexes, constraints, transactions, and data validation.
* Experience integrating Java applications with relational databases.
* Ability to investigate and resolve database-related application issues.

****Preferred****

* Experience with Hibernate or other object-relational mapping approaches.
* Familiarity with database performance optimization, schema changes, data migration, or stored procedures.
* Exposure to data-access patterns, transaction management, and database testing practices.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Ability to understand application deployment, configuration, availability, scalability, and monitoring in distributed or cloud-enabled environments.

****Preferred****

* Experience developing, deploying, or supporting Java applications in cloud environments.
* Familiarity with containerized application deployment, environment configuration, cloud application services, or application monitoring.
* Awareness of resource-efficient application design and cloud cost considerations.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Experience with one or more of Spring, Hibernate, or JSF.
* Understanding of Java web application development.
* Experience developing, consuming, or integrating RESTful web services.
* Ability to work with application components, service layers, persistence layers, and web interfaces relevant to the assigned solution.

****Preferred****

* Experience with multiple Java web development frameworks.
* Familiarity with frontend integration, reusable web components, responsive design, or frontend testing.
* Exposure to API integration, service-layer design, and application modernization practices.

**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****

* Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.
* Experience using Git or an equivalent version control system.
* Experience with code reviews, debugging, defect resolution, testing, and software development lifecycle activities.
* Ability to follow coding standards, branching practices, release processes, and documentation requirements.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams during iterative software delivery.

****Preferred****

* Experience with automated unit, integration, API, or web application testing.
* Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.
* Experience with build automation, code-quality analysis, issue tracking, logging, and application monitoring tools.
* Exposure to iterative development, technical estimation, and release planning.

**Security Protocols**
****Essential****

* Understanding of secure application development practices for Java applications, web systems, databases, and RESTful services.
* Awareness of authentication, authorization, input validation, secure data handling, and protection of sensitive information.
* Ability to identify and address security-related defects in collaboration with relevant technical teams.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with secure API design, encryption, access control, session management, and common web application security risks.
* Experience applying security, privacy, and compliance requirements during development, testing, and release activities.

****Experience Requirements****

* 5–10 years of experience in Java software development or related application development roles.
* Experience developing and maintaining Java-based applications and systems.
* Experience with Java web development frameworks such as Spring, Hibernate, or JSF.
* Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
* Experience with Agile software development methodologies.
* Experience using version control systems such as Git.
* Experience developing, consuming, or integrating RESTful web services.
* Industry experience in software development, technology, enterprise applications, or related environments is preferred.
* Candidates may also qualify through equivalent combinations of Java backend development, web application development, application integration, software engineering, or full-stack development experience that demonstrate the required skills and outcomes.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Develop, enhance, test, and maintain Java applications, web components, database integrations, and RESTful web services.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams during requirements discussions, Agile ceremonies, technical reviews, code reviews, and feature delivery activities.
* Investigate defects and application issues, implement fixes, update technical documentation, and contribute to application quality, performance, and maintainability improvements.
* Make implementation decisions within the agreed technical scope, manage assigned priorities, and escalate risks, dependencies, or design concerns when required.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Certification in Java, software development, Agile delivery, cloud technologies, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
* Relevant training in Java, Java EE, web development frameworks, RESTful services, databases, secure development, testing, or Agile methodologies is preferred.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through technical training, hands-on learning, knowledge sharing, and awareness of evolving Java and related technologies.

**Professional Competencies**

* Apply structured problem-solving and analytical reasoning to debug complex issues, evaluate technical options, and develop effective solutions.
* Work effectively in a team environment, contribute to code reviews, share technical knowledge, and support common engineering practices.
* Communicate technical information, progress, risks, dependencies, and implementation decisions clearly in written and verbal formats.
* Adapt to changing requirements, application architectures, technology versions, development practices, and delivery priorities.
* Identify opportunities to improve application design, code quality, performance, scalability, maintainability, usability, and sustainable operation.
* Manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, maintain attention to detail, organize work appropriately, and deliver within agreed timelines and quality expectations.

description:
**Description**
Are you seeking an environment where you can apply state-of-the-art computer science techniques, build large-scale distributed systems, and directly impact how millions of customers experience ultra-fast delivery? Do you want to build the next generation of Quick Commerce fulfillment technology from the ground up?
  
  
Amazon's Quick Commerce (QC) business is scaling rapidly across multiple cities, fulfilling hundreds of thousands of daily orders with high expansion targets. We are building a brand-new QC under-the roof-fulfillment stack on AFT foundations.
  
  
Join the QC Fulfillment Technology team and be part of developing large-scale, composable, work-cell-based systems that power our micro-stores - from inbound receiving and guided stowing to picking, staging, and last-mile handoff. These systems will be used by thousands of store associates to delight millions of customers with 10-minute delivery. In this role, the SDE will be responsible for designing, developing, and operating scalable fulfillment services.
  
  
This is a true 0→1 opportunity where your code will directly impact how Quick Commerce fulfillment operates at Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable services and APIs for the QC fulfillment stack
* Develop systems that enforce operational controls beyond Amazon sites, including external fulfillment environments with our 3P partners
* Collaborate with Senior SDEs, Principal Engineers, TPMs, and Product Managers to define technical solutions that solve fulfillment challenges at scale
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following Amazon's engineering best practices
* Drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency, targeting industry-leading speeds
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical planning sessions
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to raising the engineering bar across the team
* Work in a fast-paced, agile environment with rapid iteration cycles, shipping new capabilities in weeks not months

**About The Team**
We are a fast-paced and focused team of passionate Amazonians building industry-leading Quick Commerce fulfillment technology. We are standing up QC fulfillment stack that will scale beyond Amazon sites and beyond India. Our team is part of AFT, and works closely with IN Tez (QC), DEX, Speed Fulfillment teams, following a collaborative engagement model with joint workshops, and dedicated SME support.
  
  
The team values high ownership, bias for action, and insists on the highest standards while following a build-fast-and-iterate-fast methodology. We believe in speed through autonomy and safety through guardrails.
  
  
This team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to architecture and product strategy while building high-performing, scalable systems that directly impact Quick Commerce operations and Amazon Now's growth.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience in agile/scrum or related collaborative workflow, or experience operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets
* Experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround
* Experience working in fulfillment, logistics, or supply chain technology

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Video Platform Engineer - E3
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a "100,000-year data gap"—the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork's answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments—kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, and homes—to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world's leading robotics labs use to train their foundation models.
  
  
**About The Role**
Every dataset IRL ships starts as raw video: multi-camera rigs recording a worker palletizing a warehouse order, cooking a meal, or turning over a hotel room. Many hours of synchronized streams per session, plus the telemetry captured alongside them, growing into petabytes.
  
  
As a Video Platform Engineer, you'll own the pipeline that turns that raw capture into training-ready data: ingest, transcode, time-synchronization, automate video quality checks, indexing, and delivery to the robotics labs that train on it.
  
  
This is a hybrid media-engineering and distributed-systems role. You'll make codec and container decisions. You'll design orchestration that survives a rig failing mid-session. And you'll own the cost per captured hour of processing.
  
  
You'll help shape the roadmap by working directly with the data collection teams in the field, and you'll have real say in which of their problems we solve first.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  

* 5+ years building and operating production video or media processing systems at scale.
* Hands-on, production experience with FFmpeg, GStreamer, or an equivalent media framework. You've built a pipeline around it and debugged it under load.
* Fluency in codecs and containers: H.264/HEVC/AV1, MP4/fMP4, and the practical tradeoffs between them.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, object storage, and observability.
* Strong programming and problem solving skills.
* Experience with durable workflow orchestration (Temporal, Conductor, Step Functions, Airflow, or similar).
* Experience designing cost-efficient architectures for large media or data workloads, and a working understanding of storage tiering, egress, capacity planning, and GPU utilization.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, and production operations.

\\*\\*Preferred\\*\\*
  
  

* Multi-camera, multi-view, or time-synchronized capture systems, and the clock-drift and alignment problems that come with them.
* Robotics or sensor data formats: MCAP, rosbag, ROS/ROS2, Parquet, or similar columnar and log formats.
* Familiarity with machine learning on video or images. Classification, detection and tracking, segmentation, re-identification, super-resolution, quality scoring, auto-annotation, redaction.
* Perceptual quality measurement (VMAF or equivalent) and encoding-ladder design.
* Streaming and packaging formats: HLS, DASH, CMAF, and DRM integration.
* Range across the stack. If you've built the annotation or review tooling on top of your own pipeline, we want to hear about it.

What You'll Do
  
  

* Design and build the ingest path from capture rigs to cloud storage, resilient to partial uploads, flaky field networks, and mid-session hardware failure.
* Build transcoding and normalization pipelines that turn heterogeneous rig output into consistent, analysis-ready media.
* Time-synchronize multi-camera video with telemetry and sensor streams into coherent, labeled episodes.
* Build automated quality checks that flag unusable sessions before they reach a customer - blur, exposure failure, dropped frames, etc.
* Design dataset versioning, lineage, and indexing so that any shipped episode can be traced back to its raw capture.
* Build the delivery path that gets datasets to robotics labs, including packaging, integrity verification, and access control.
* Own cost per captured hour and cost per delivered dataset: storage tiering and lifecycle, egress, encoding efficiency, and GPU utilization.
* Improve observability across the pipeline—monitoring, logging, tracing, and per-stage throughput and failure metrics.
* Troubleshoot complex issues spanning media tooling, storage, networking, and application code.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and own diagnosis and resolution of production issues.
* Participate in code reviews and raise the technical bar through clear, practical feedback.
* Own complex initiatives from problem definition through design, implementation, and operation.
* Measure and improve pipeline throughput, end-to-end latency from capture to delivery, dataset yield, reliability, incident recovery time, and infrastructure cost per workload.

Perks
  
  

* Free snacks
* Health Insurance
* Personal Insurance
* Flexible Hours
* Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Broadband Reimbursement

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Sr. Python Engineer
description:
Our customer is seeking an exceptional Senior Python Engineer to design and build the software backbone of the platform that powers our real-time analytics, AI/ML initiatives, and enterprise reporting for the automotive service industry. This is not a scripting role. We are looking for an engineer who treats Python as a first-class software engineering language: someone who designs layered, extensible systems, writes libraries other engineers build on, and can reason about concurrency, memory, performance, and maintainability at scale.

You will turn long-running, manual, and tribal-knowledge processes into well-architected, tested, and observable Python services and frameworks that run against high-volume operational data — on the order of hundreds of thousands of repair-order records per day — flowing through our AWS and Snowflake ecosystem.

Most important: deep, demonstrable Python mastery and a track record of architecting complex Python systems (frameworks, SDKs, distributed processing engines, or plugin-based platforms). We will trade breadth of data-platform tooling for depth in Python; Snowflake, Airflow, and AWS specifics can be learned on the job.

* **Experience**
  : 7+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 5 years building production systems primarily in Python.
* **Python mastery (primary)**
  : Expert-level command of the language and its internals — data model, typing system, iterators/generators, decorators, descriptors, metaclasses, context managers, memory model, and the GIL. You can explain why, not just how.
* **Complex Python architecture**
  : Proven experience designing and owning large, multi-module Python codebases or frameworks used by other engineers — not only standalone scripts or notebooks.
* **Concurrency & performance**
  : Hands-on production experience with asyncio and/or multiprocessing, and a track record of profiling and measurably improving the speed or memory footprint of Python systems.
* **Testing discipline**
  : Deep experience with pytest and test design for complex systems, including mocking strategy, integration testing, and test-driven development.
* **Data handling**
  : Strong experience processing large datasets in Python (Polars, pandas, PyArrow, DuckDB, or similar), dataframe and schema validation (Pandera or Pydantic), and solid working SQL.
* **Modern Python ecosystem**
  : Current with Python 3.12+ and modern tooling — uv, ruff, pyright/mypy, Pydantic v2, async-native libraries (httpx, asyncpg/aiohttp) — and able to evaluate new runtime features critically.
* **Engineering practices**
  : Git-based workflows, CI/CD, packaging and dependency management, containerization, and strong documentation habits (design docs, READMEs, runbooks).
* **Data platform exposure**
  : Experience with Snowflake, Airflow (including custom operators/DAG factories), dbt, or Databricks/PySpark is preferred.
* **AWS & event-driven systems**
  : Hands-on use of S3, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, or ECS from Python, including idempotent consumers for Kafka, Kinesis, or SQS is added advantage.
* **Performance extensions**
  : Experience with Cython, Rust bindings (PyO3), or Numba, or with running workloads on the free-threaded CPython build is added advantage.
* **LLM & agent frameworks**
  : Hands-on experience with MCP server development, LangGraph, Pydantic AI, or similar agent frameworks, and with LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock is added advantage.
* **Automotive domain**
  : Familiarity with repair-order, dealership fixed-operations, or DMS data is a plus.

Because this role centers on Python architecture, we ask every candidate to include a short write-up (one page or less) or a link to code that answers the following:

* **A complex Python system you architected**
  : What problem did it solve, how was it structured (modules, layers, key abstractions), and why did you choose that design over the alternatives?
* **Scale and performance**
  : What were the volume, concurrency, or latency constraints, and how did you profile and optimize the system to meet them?
* **Extensibility and quality**
  : How did other engineers extend your code, how did you keep it tested and maintainable, and what would you design differently today?
* **AI in your workflow**
  : How do you use AI coding assistants or LLM-powered tooling in your engineering work, and how do you keep the output production-quality?
* Shortlisted candidates should expect a technical interview that includes a live architecture discussion and an in-depth review of real Python code.

title: Senior Installation Package Development & Validation Engineer (Contract)
description:
**Senior Installation Package Development & Validation Engineer (Contract role)**
**Focus Areas**
: MSI InstallShield (Windows) & Linux/Unix InstallAnywhere Automation
  
  
**Role Type:**
Contractor – 6 months
  
  
**Primary Focus:**
Installer Engineering, Packaging & Release Validation
  
  
InstallShield (MSI), InstallAnywhere, VBScript / Custom Actions, Java / JDBC, Gradle (Kotlin DSL), GitHub Actions, Active Directory / gMSA, Docker
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a
**Senior Installation Package Specialist**
to own, modernize, and automate the multi-platform installer ecosystem. In this critical role, you will be responsible for end-to-end packaging engineering from developing Windows InstallShield (.msi) and Linux/Unix InstallAnywhere (.iap\\_xml) installer payloads to orchestrating custom build tasks in Gradle, automating database provisioning via JDBC, and ensuring seamless enterprise upgrades across thousands of mission-critical customer environments.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with Core Engineering, Security, and Quality Engineering teams to eliminate installation roadblocks, enhance silent/unattended rollout capabilities, support modern enterprise security standards (gMSA, CyberArk PAM), and maintain zero-downtime upgrade integrity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**- Dual-Platform Installer Development & Maintenance
- Windows Packaging (InstallShield MSI): Maintain and enhance InstallShield project files (.ism) for flagship Windows products.
- Linux/Unix Packaging (InstallAnywhere): Develop and configure Revenera InstallAnywhere (.iap\\_xml) project files for Unix based repo installers.
- Custom Action Engineering: Design, write, and maintain:

* Windows VBScript / JScript Custom Actions: Develop Immediate and Deferred custom actions (with elevated privilege handling and rollback logic) for configuration gathering, service registration, and file manipulation.
* Java Custom Actions: Develop compiled Java classes for InstallAnywhere runtime execution to handle cross-platform setup logic.
* Enterprise Security & Silent Deployment Logic
* Group Managed Service Accounts (gMSA): Maintain and validate installer logic for running core services under Windows gMSA credentials in both UI and Silent Response File modes.
* Property File Retention & Upgrade Reliability: Fix complex upgrade bugs to ensure property files (master.props, db.props) are safely backed up, migrated, and never overwritten or deleted during reinstalls/upgrades.
* Version String Comparison Logic: Implement precise multi-digit semantic version comparison logic (e.g., 4-digit releases like 2026.3.4.19) to prevent upgrade blockage or false "newer version already installed" errors.
* Database Provisioning & Schema Orchestration
* JDBC Engine Integration: Work with the shared DB assistant Java CLI tool to orchestrate database connectivity validation and schema deployment.
* Multi-Dialect DDL Alignment: Ensure installer schema execution scripts correctly apply to repository tables, supporting emerging DB topologies such as Oracle Pluggable Databases (PDB), Azure SQL, and PostgreSQL.
* Build System & CI/CD Automation
* Gradle Multi-Module Pipeline: Maintain shared custom Gradle build-logic tasks
* Mutagen Staging Workflow: Manage local macOS/Linux staging builds that sync VM-layout payload ZIPs to Windows and Unix packaging build VMs via Mutagen.
* GitHub Actions & Automated Testing: Build and maintain CI/CD workflows and integrate pre-initialized Docker containers (MSSQL/PostgreSQL) for automated integration testing.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise software packaging, installation engineering, and installer validation across Windows and Linux environments.
* InstallShield Expertise: Advanced knowledge of Revenera InstallShield, Windows Installer (MSI) technology, MSI tables, sequence tables, custom action execution contexts (Immediate vs. Deferred in System Context), and rollback execution.
* InstallAnywhere Expertise: Hands-on experience developing Linux/Unix installers using Revenera InstallAnywhere, including Java custom actions, panel rules, and response file handling.
* Scripting Languages: Strong proficiency in VBScript, PowerShell, Bash and/or Python.
* Java & JDBC: Solid understanding of Java runtime configuration, JAR packaging, and JDBC database connectivity.
* Database Fundamentals: Practical working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle Database (DDL execution, user/role permissions, tablespaces/PDBs).
* Enterprise Security: In-depth understanding of Windows Service logons, active directory user rights gMSA (Group Managed Service Accounts), and ACL permissions.
* Build Tools & CI/CD: Experience with Gradle (Kotlin or Groovy DSL), Git, and CI/CD platforms like GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

**Desirable Plus Qualifications**

* Experience with CyberArk PAM, OAuth2, or PKI certificate management for enterprise service credentials.
* Experience with Docker for running pre-initialized integration testing database containers.

title: Senior Software QA Automation Engineer – Java, API, Microservices & Performance Testing
description:
**Company:**
Triaxa FZCO

**Location:**
Remote / Hybrid (India timezone preferred)

**Employment Type:**
part-time

**Experience:**
5+ years

**Role Type:**
Hands-on Individual Contributor / QA Automation & Quality Engineering

About Triaxa

Triaxa is building scalable, cloud-native technology platforms using modern microservices architectures, distributed systems, APIs, and AWS infrastructure.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on
**Senior Software QA Automation Engineer**
to independently own functional testing, API automation, integration testing, regression testing, and performance validation across our products.

Our platforms involve Java-based backend services, asynchronous messaging, cloud infrastructure, databases, and interconnected services.

The ideal candidate must go beyond executing manual test cases. We need someone capable of understanding system architecture, building automated test frameworks, identifying complex integration defects, and ensuring reliable software releases.

Key Responsibilities

1. API & Backend Testing

* Design and execute functional, integration, negative, and regression tests for REST APIs and backend services.
* Build automated API testing frameworks using Java, REST Assured, JUnit 5, TestNG, or equivalent tools.
* Validate API authentication, authorization, request validation, response structures, error handling, and business rules.
* Test idempotency, pagination, filtering, rate limiting, retries, and timeout handling.
* Validate API contracts and compatibility between dependent services.
* Test authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0, JWT, HMAC signatures, and API keys.

1. Microservices & Integration Testing

* Develop automated integration tests for Spring Boot microservices.
* Validate communication between synchronous APIs and asynchronous services.
* Test Apache Kafka messaging, event consumption, ordering, duplication, retries, and failure recovery.
* Validate database operations involving MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, and other data stores.
* Test workflows spanning multiple services and external integrations.
* Use mocks, stubs, and test containers to create reliable and repeatable testing environments.
* Identify data consistency, race conditions, and transaction-related defects.

1. End-to-End Product Testing

* Own end-to-end testing across frontend applications, backend APIs, and supporting infrastructure.
* Validate critical business workflows from request submission through final processing and reporting.
* Test multi-tenant applications, tenant isolation, role-based access, and user permissions.
* Validate bulk processing, background jobs, event-driven workflows, and scheduled tasks.
* Test error recovery, partial failures, and system behavior under unexpected conditions.
* Ensure that changes in one module do not introduce defects in dependent services.

1. Email Platform & SMTP Integration Testing

* Validate transactional and marketing email workflows.
* Test message submission, scheduling, dispatch, delivery status, and event processing.
* Validate email delivery events, including accepted, delivered, bounced, deferred, complaints, and suppressions.
* Test SMTP integration, webhook processing, and delivery-event reconciliation.
* Validate duplicate event handling, retry mechanisms, and message idempotency.
* Test unsubscribe processing, recipient suppression, sender configuration, and domain-verification workflows.
* Validate attachment handling, file scanning statuses, and error scenarios.
* Verify accurate reporting and consistency between backend events and application dashboards.

1. UI Automation Testing

* Develop and maintain automated UI regression tests using Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools.
* Validate user journeys across administrative dashboards and customer-facing applications.
* Test forms, input validation, navigation, account management, and permission-controlled features.
* Verify frontend and backend data consistency.
* Perform cross-browser testing for critical workflows.
* Identify usability and functional defects affecting customer operations.

1. Performance, Load & Reliability Testing

* Design performance and load tests for APIs, background workers, and distributed processing systems.
* Use tools such as JMeter, k6, or Gatling.
* Measure throughput, response times, latency, error rates, and resource utilization.
* Identify bottlenecks in APIs, databases, Kafka consumers, and service integrations.
* Test concurrency, high-volume processing, retry behavior, and system recovery.
* Coordinate with developers and infrastructure engineers to investigate performance issues.
* Validate platform behavior under agreed workload and capacity targets.

1. Test Automation & CI/CD Integration

* Build reusable automation frameworks using maintainable design patterns.
* Integrate automated testing into Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and other CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement automated smoke, regression, integration, and release-validation suites.
* Generate clear test execution reports and quality metrics.
* Maintain automated test datasets and reusable environment configurations.
* Reduce flaky tests and improve automation reliability.
* Establish appropriate quality gates before deployments.

1. Defect Management & Release Quality

* Analyze requirements and translate them into test plans, scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify functional gaps, integration risks, and missing edge cases before development is completed.
* Report defects with clear reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, logs, and technical evidence.
* Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot and resolve complex defects.
* Verify bug fixes and perform impact-based regression testing.
* Maintain requirement-to-test traceability and release-readiness reports.
* Provide independent quality assessments before major releases.

Mandatory Technical Skills

Candidates must demonstrate hands-on experience with:

* **Programming:**
  Strong Java skills for developing automated test frameworks.
* **API Testing:**
  REST Assured, Postman, HTTP/JSON, and REST API automation.
* **Testing Frameworks:**
  JUnit 5, TestNG, Mockito, and integration testing.
* **Backend:**
  Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
* **Messaging:**
  Apache Kafka and asynchronous event-driven workflows.
* **Databases:**
  SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and database validation.
* **UI Automation:**
  Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent.
* **Performance Testing:**
  JMeter, k6, or Gatling.
* **CI/CD:**
  Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git, Maven, or Gradle.
* **Containers:**
  Docker and Testcontainers.
* **Testing Practices:**
  Functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, negative, and performance testing.
* **Debugging:**
  Ability to interpret logs, trace API requests, inspect database records, and investigate distributed-system failures.

Good to Have

* Experience with AWS and Kubernetes/EKS environments.
* Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Knowledge of Redis, object storage, and distributed transactions.
* Familiarity with email delivery systems, SMTP, DKIM, SPF, DMARC, and email event processing.
* Experience with asynchronous workflows, event reconciliation, and eventual consistency.
* Understanding of security-related functional testing, such as access control and tenant isolation.
* Familiarity with observability tools, centralized logging, and distributed tracing.
* Experience with contract testing, Pact, WireMock, or similar tools.
* Experience in high-volume messaging, notification, or marketing automation systems.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for an engineer who:

* Has 5+ years of hands-on software QA and test automation experience.
* Can independently design and implement automation frameworks.
* Has strong backend, API, and microservices testing expertise.
* Understands distributed systems and complex integration workflows.
* Can write production-quality test automation code.
* Is capable of validating functionality beyond basic happy-path scenarios.
* Can investigate defects across applications, databases, queues, and infrastructure.
* Has experience with performance and high-volume testing.
* Works proactively with developers and infrastructure engineers.
* Takes ownership of product quality and release readiness.

What Success Looks Like

* Critical API and backend workflows are covered by reliable automated tests.
* New features undergo integration and regression testing before release.
* Complex microservice interactions are validated end-to-end.
* Functional defects are identified before deployment to production.
* Kafka processing, retries, idempotency, and failure-recovery scenarios are tested.
* UI and backend behavior remain consistent.
* Performance testing identifies bottlenecks before major releases.
* Automated testing is integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Releases are supported by clear test evidence, defect tracking, and quality reports.

Hiring Process

Shortlisted candidates will undergo a practical technical evaluation covering:

* Building a Java REST Assured API automation framework.
* Writing Spring Boot integration tests using JUnit 5 and Testcontainers.
* Testing Kafka events, duplicate processing, and retry behavior.
* Validating database state after API operations.
* Designing end-to-end scenarios for a distributed application.
* Demonstrating performance testing fundamentals.
* Debugging failed automated tests using logs and execution evidence.
* **We are specifically looking for a hands-on QA Automation Engineer who can independently develop test automation, validate complex backend integrations, and take ownership of release quality—not someone whose experience is limited to manual testing or executing predefined test cases.**

This senior individual contributor will work deeply in Snowflake and SQL, understand Salesforce data structures, consolidate data from multiple systems, and create trusted datasets for reporting and analytics. Key partners include Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Client Success Operations, Finance, Marketing Operations, Business Applications, Data / BI, Sales and CS leadership

Consolidate Salesforce and other GTM system data into a single, reportable source of truth.

Create governed datasets for pipeline, bookings, forecast, renewals, expansion, churn, hierarchy, product, territory, and sales performance reporting.

•

Define transformation logic, business rules, joins, filters, exclusions, and documentation needed to make data usable and repeatable.

Reconcile Salesforce and Snowflake data so core revenue metrics match across systems.

Identify duplicate, incomplete, inconsistent, stale, or misclassified revenue data.

•

Create repeatable rules for data normalization, account hierarchy, territory assignment, product mapping, opportunity classification, renewal logic, and lifecycle status.

•

Maintain mapping tables, data dictionaries, metric definitions, lineage documentation, and QA logic.

Multi-System Consolidation

Proactively flag risks, gaps, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs before they impact reporting.

Better alignment between Salesforce, Snowflake, BI dashboards, and Finance reporting.

Zywave | Confidential

•

A clearer GTM source of truth for pipeline, bookings, forecast, renewals, expansion, churn, territory, hierarchy, and customer reporting.

•

Fewer conflicting reports and fewer manual reconciliation exercises.

•

Cleaner account hierarchy, ownership, product, territory, and opportunity classification logic.

•

Better documentation of lineage, metric definitions, transformation rules, caveats, and automated data-quality checks.

•

Improved trust in leadership reporting and operating cadences.

Required Qualifications

5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, data operations, BI engineering, RevOps analytics, or a related data role.

•

Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience in Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse.

•

Experience building curated reporting tables, analytical datasets, data models, semantic layers, or BI-ready views.

•

Strong understanding of Salesforce data structures, including accounts, leads, contacts, opportunities, products, quotes, activities, users, roles, and hierarchy-related data.

•

Experience reconciling data across multiple systems and resolving source-of-truth conflicts.

title: Data & Automations Analyst
description:
**Data & Automations Analyst – SiliconPath Law**

**Role overview**

The Data & Automations Analyst finds the repeatable work in SiliconPath Law’s case workflow and makes it faster, more accurate, and safer using AI and automation. They also give leadership a clear, live view of how the firm is performing. This person builds tools and dashboards that case managers, immigration specialists, content writers, paralegals, attorneys, and leadership use every day.

**Core responsibilities**

* **Workflow automation:**
  Automate handoffs, reminders, and routine messages in our case management system, such as welcome emails, document requests, and recommender follow-ups.
* **Document checks:**
  Build tools that flag missing, illegible, outdated, or inconsistent documents before the immigration specialist reviews them.
* **Drafting support:**
  Create and maintain AI prompts, templates, and workflows for first drafts of letters of recommendation (LORs), personal statements, and petition sections, with built-in checks that every number and date matches the evidence.
* **Reporting:**
  Automate the weekly client progress reports, attorney case summaries, and the progress tracker.
* **Dashboards and analytics:**
  Build and maintain dashboards that give leadership a live view of the firm, including the case pipeline and stages, turnaround times, document and signature delays, team capacity against role ratios, role KPIs, and Request for Evidence (RFE) trends.
* **Responsible AI and data protection:**
  Ensure every AI tool the team uses protects client data, and set and maintain SPL’s guidelines for safe AI use.
* **Training and adoption:**
  Train the team on new tools, gather feedback, and keep improving what’s been built.
* **Measuring impact:**
  Track time saved, error rates, and adoption for every tool, and report the results to leadership.

**What we look for**

* **Process analysis:**
  You can map a messy workflow and spot exactly where automation will help most.
* **AI implementation:**
  You know how to get reliable, accurate results from AI tools, and how to test them.
* **Automation building:**
  You build working automations and integrations, not just recommend them.
* **Data and reporting:**
  You turn raw data into clear dashboards and reports that help people make decisions.

**Key skills**

* Google Apps Script and JavaScript
* No-code or low-code automation tools (for example, Zapier, Make, or n8n)
* Working with APIs and integrations
* Using large language models (LLMs) and writing effective prompts
* Building dashboards in a BI tool (for example, Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau)
* Data privacy and security basics

**Nice to have:**
Python, SQL, and experience in legal tech or professional services.

title: Senior Principal SRE Engineering
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About The Technology Organization**
Technology at Lilly builds and operates mission-critical digital products and platforms that support the discovery, development, and delivery of medicines that make life better for people around the world. Our teams operate in highly regulated, high-availability environments, where operational excellence, reliability, and quality are non-negotiable.
  
  
Within Tech@Lilly, the Digital Core organization applies a product, platform, and reliability-first mindset, ensuring that operational capabilities scale sustainably across the enterprise.
  
  
**About The Team**
Tech@Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using pioneering technologies like the most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we redefine what's possible through tech to advance our purpose, creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, including data-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, resilient enterprise platforms, and intelligent digital operations. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver creative solutions in every area of our business.
  
  
The Digital Core team leads Lilly's transformation into the Digital and AI era. They inspire digitally empowered teams to new ways of working and accelerate innovation and agility. This team powers and advances the entire company by building and maintaining world-class technology capabilities and platforms.
  
  
Lilly Capability Centre India (LCCI), Hyderabad, is Lilly's premier Global Technology Hub, harnessing data, AI, analytics, and digital solutions to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes worldwide.
  
  
The Reliability Engineering team is the engineering-first function that owns the stability, observability, and operational quality of a multi-application production estate. It operates in close partnership with the engineering team that builds the agentic automation platform, and is in active transition from human-executed operations to engineering-led, agent-assisted reliability.
  
  
Role summary
  
  
As the Senior Principal SRE Engineering Lead, you are the senior-most engineering authority for the reliability of the supported production estate. You own the bar for what reliable means in this organization: service-level objectives, error-budget governance, observability standards, and the engineering practices that protect both production and the team's engineering time.
  
  
This role is the judgment layer between an agent's recommendation and a production change. You combine engineering rigor with operational pragmatism, and you decide which patterns surfaced from production warrant durable engineering investment. You hold the SRE engineering bar within the function — the cross-pillar reference architecture is owned by the Senior Architect, but the practice, standards, and engineering judgment of reliability at this site are yours.
  
  
You are a senior individual contributor. You do not manage people. You partner with the Reliability Leader, the Senior Principal Tech Shift Lead in the same pillar, the Senior Architect, and the senior engineering principals in the agentic automation team. Success is measured by organizational impact, sustained reliability outcomes, and the ability to scale reliability through systems and people, not heroics.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Reliability strategy and SLO governance
* Define service-level objectives and indicators across the supported production estate, tiered by application risk and business impact.
* Govern error-budget burn: when to slow change, when to invest in durable fixes, when to accept the budget.
* Drive the adoption of reliability reporting and the disciplined operating cadence that makes SLOs real, not decorative.
* Hold the SLO and error-budget conversation with product and application owners — including the conversation about what their service needs to change to meet the bar.
* Engineering standards, observability, and self-healing
* Establish observability and instrumentation standards as the contract every supported application must meet — and hold the line on them.
* Set the bar for infrastructure-as-code, continuous-delivery hardening, and deployment safety across the supported estate.
* Define the engineering work that flows from incidents and root-cause analyses into durable production change, and the architectural patterns (self-healing runbooks, graceful degradation, circuit breakers) that reduce repeat failure.
* Incident learning, durable fixes, and partnership with agentic automation
* Drive blameless postmortem culture; ensure root-cause analyses produce engineering work, not just narrative.
* Govern which patterns from production warrant durable engineering investment, against the error-budget regime.
* Partner with the production operations team in the same pillar on which patterns from the field warrant engineering attention; partner with the agentic automation engineering team on which fixes become safe agent-assisted remediations, and on the confidence thresholds, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop boundaries that make those remediations safe in production.
* Lead high-severity incident response as incident commander when escalation reaches this seat, and coach the team to handle the rest.
* Compliance, security, and regulated-environment readiness
* Ensure reliability practices comply with Lilly standards and applicable regulatory requirements, and engineer them so that audit evidence falls out of normal operation.
* Promote secure operational practices, auditability, and validated-environment-friendly engineering as part of the standards the team holds.
* Act as a trusted technical leader in regulated and validated environments.
* Technical leadership and talent development
* Set the engineering bar through standards, expectations, and role modeling.
* Mentor senior reliability engineers in the pillar; build the bench for sustained team growth and develop the next layer of principal engineers.
* Influence engineering, product, and platform leaders through credibility and outcomes rather than authority.
* Contribute to the evolution of enterprise-wide reliability practices in partnership with the Senior Architect and peer technical leaders.

How you will succeed
  
  
At the senior-most engineering individual-contributor level for reliability, success is defined by breadth of impact and sustained outcomes:
  
  

* Be recognized as the senior reliability authority for your area.
* Demonstrate measurable, sustained improvements such as: reduced major incidents, fewer recurring failures, improved time-to-recovery, and a credible error-budget regime.
* Influence decisions across multiple teams and leaders through expertise and trust.
* Scale reliability through systems, standards, and people, not heroics.

What you should bring
  
  
**Required**

* 14+ years of progressive engineering experience, with at least 6 years as a Site Reliability Engineer, Production Engineer, or equivalent, including a tour as the senior-most reliability engineer for a multi-application production estate — not a single product.
* Production reliability experience in a regulated or audited environment (GxP, SOX, HIPAA, PCI, or equivalent), including familiarity with change-control discipline, audit evidence, and validated-system constraints.
* Hands-on ownership of an SLO/SLI framework and error-budget policy across a multi-application estate, including defining SLIs, negotiating SLOs with product owners, and operationalizing burn-rate alerting and error-budget governance.
* Deep, hands-on fluency across the SRE technical stack: observability and OpenTelemetry (Splunk, Datadog, New Relic, or Grafana/Prometheus); infrastructure-as-code (Terraform); CI/CD pipeline hardening and progressive delivery; Kubernetes and container platforms; and at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Track record of leading high-severity incident response as incident commander, running blameless postmortems, and converting findings into durable engineering work — measured by reduced recurrence rather than narrative quality.
* Demonstrated technical leadership at scale: mentoring senior ICs, influencing engineering and product leaders without org-chart authority, and writing the standards and engineering documents that set the bar for a discipline.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related engineering field.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience designing self-healing automation and running chaos engineering or resilience-testing programs (AWS Fault Injection Service, Gremlin, LitmusChaos, or equivalent) tied to measurable reliability gains.
* Deep AWS fluency across reliability-relevant services (EKS, ECS, Lambda, CloudWatch, X-Ray, Systems Manager, Route 53), and familiarity with AWS Well-Architected Reliability Pillar.
* Experience with AIOps or agent-assisted operations, including designing the guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop boundaries that make automated remediation safe in production.
* Track record of saying no to a deploy because the error budget was burned, and making the call stick.
* Prior experience building a reliability practice from a small founding team.
* Experience operating in pharma, healthcare, financial services, or other regulated industries.

Leadership expectations
  
  

* Acts as the judgment layer between aspiration and engineering reality.
* Combines engineering rigor with operational pragmatism, and knows when each is the right answer.

title: Solution Engineer - Operations
description:
**About Signant Health**

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

**About The Role**

Solution Engineer is responsible for working with Sponsors/Customers, Clinical, Global Project Management (GPM), Data Management and across the matrixed Global Technical Delivery (GTD) to design solutions for clinical trials utilizing Signant Health’s product portfolio. They analyse study protocol requirements and define solutions considering scientific guidance, electronic clinical outcome assessment (eCOA) best practices and Signant’s products and standards. They play a key role in ensuring the project meets the study needs and is feasible to implement, based upon the capabilities and limitations of the product, in the quoted timelines and budget. They are responsible for understanding business needs and translating them into system requirements. They may assist with the development and documentation of processes and procedures.

**Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad or Noida (Remote opportunity)**

**Shift Timings: India - 5:30 PM - 2:30 AM**

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function**

* Collaborate with other Solution Engineers, and others as determined, to ensure questionnaires, clinical trial protocol, and overall design requirements are understood and can be implemented as well as analyse the protocol/scope to collate the design requirements for simple to moderate complexity projects.
* Produce functional requirements documentation based upon design requirements shared by Senior and/or Lead Solution Engineer, as necessary.
* Utilize all available tools and information sources to understand requirements, including interviews/meetings, document analysis, use cases and workflow analysis.
* Update and mange requirements/specifications as needed throughout the software development lifecycle. Follows defined validation processes and produces validated documents for all questionnaires.
* Evaluate information gathered from multiple sources, work with stakeholders to reconcile conflicting information, identify/evaluate potential risks and translate abstract or high-level requirements into useful/actionable implementation.
* Ensures best practices and standards are followed in every implementation.
* Liaise with Localization to facilitate the development of translated versions of the master questionnaire (This is Rater Station Specific)
* May be responsible for application configuration.
* They provide support for SDLC and validation documents as well as facilitate the review and approval of all documents. (This is Rater Station Specific)

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**

**Essential:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of professional role.
* 2-3 years experience functioning as Business Analyst or similar role.
* In depth experience with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) implementation
* Gathering information from a wide variety of sources and subsequently crafting it into effective and audience-appropriate technical and non-technical documentation.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills and a desire to solve problems.
* Ability to resolve conflicts between people and competing goals and interests.
* Desire for developing one’s own skills: technical, clinical, and interpersonal.
* Have good communication abilities via writing, quality documentation and presenting in meetings. Delivers information effectively and timely. Uses interpersonal skills to build and develop relationships with internal and external team members.
* Needs to be an effective, positive team player, and a self-starter, with moderate level of guidance and direction.
* Must have very strong skills with Microsoft Office application to include the following: Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint
* Proficiency in HTML and CSS for questionnaire configuration and system customization purposes.

**DECISION MAKING AND INFLUENCE:**

* Own the design elements of the questionnaires and system requirements.
* Responsible to identify and communicate risk.
* Responsible for establishing best practices for creation of questionnaire, system requirements, integration specifications, and overall design.
* Impact to end-user experience
* Impact to data integrity
* Interface with internal and external teams, including sponsors.

**Why Signant Health?**

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Data Governance Manager
description:
**Data Governance Lead**

**Joining:**
Immediate / ASAP

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly experienced Data Strategy, Governance & Solution Architect with 15+ years of experience across enterprise data strategy, data governance, data architecture, MDM and large-scale data transformation.

The successful candidate will be responsible for defining the Data Strategy and Data Governance framework, developing the Data Roadmap, and translating the strategy into a portfolio of executable projects. Each project should have a clear business case, delivery objectives, benefits, dependencies and measurable outcomes.

This is a senior, hands-on role requiring a combination of strategy consulting, architecture, governance and implementation experience. The individual should be a strong Solution Architect who can bridge business strategy and technical execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Strategy & Roadmap**

* **Define and establish the enterprise Data Strategy, aligned to business objectives and technology strategy.**
* **Assess the current data landscape, capabilities, maturity, architecture, processes and pain points.**
* **Develop the target-state Data Strategy and operating model.**
* **Create a comprehensive Data Roadmap covering short-, medium- and long-term initiatives.**
* **Translate the overall Data Strategy into a structured portfolio of projects / initiatives.**
* **Prioritise projects based on business value, risk, regulatory requirements, dependencies, cost and complexity.**
* **Define clear outcomes, milestones, dependencies and success measures for each initiative.**
* **Ensure the roadmap is realistic, actionable and aligned with enterprise architecture.**

**Strategy-to-Project Transformation**

* **Break down the overall Data Strategy into executable projects and workstreams.**
* **Develop a clear scope, objectives, deliverables and implementation approach for each project.**
* **Develop a business case for each project, including:**
* **Business problem / opportunity**
* **Expected benefits and business value**
* **Costs and investment requirements**
* **Risks and dependencies**
* **Resource requirements**
* **Delivery timeline**
* **KPIs and success criteria**
* **ROI / value realisation**
* **Support senior leadership in prioritising and approving the project portfolio.**
* **Provide architectural and strategic direction throughout project execution.**
* **Ensure individual projects remain aligned to the overall Data Strategy and target architecture.**

**Data Governance**

* **Define and implement the Enterprise Data Governance framework.**
* **Establish data governance principles, policies, standards, processes and controls.**
* **Define Data Ownership, Data Stewardship, RACI and decision rights.**
* **Establish governance forums, councils and escalation mechanisms.**
* **Define and implement governance processes covering:**
* **Data Quality**
* **Metadata Management**
* **Data Lineage**
* **Business Glossary**
* **Data Classification**
* **Data Ownership & Stewardship**
* **Data Controls**
* **Master & Reference Data**
* **Define governance KPIs and maturity measures.**
* **Drive adoption of governance practices across business and technology teams.**

**Data Retention & Archival**

* **Define and implement Data Retention and Data Archival strategies aligned with business, regulatory, legal and compliance requirements.**
* **Establish data retention policies, standards and ownership.**
* **Define archival principles and target-state archival architecture.**
* **Determine what data should be retained, archived, migrated or disposed of.**
* **Work with legal, compliance, security, business and technology stakeholders to establish appropriate retention periods.**
* **Ensure archival solutions consider accessibility, cost optimisation, security, auditability and data lifecycle management.**
* **Develop implementation roadmaps for retention and archival initiatives.**

**Data Architecture & Solution Architecture**

* **Act as a senior Data / Solution Architect across the data transformation portfolio.**
* **Define current-state and target-state Data Architecture.**
* **Develop conceptual, logical and physical data architecture where required.**
* **Translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable technical solutions.**
* **Define integration, data flow, storage, processing and consumption patterns.**
* **Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles and standards.**
* **Evaluate architectural options and provide recommendations and trade-offs.**
* **Review and govern solution designs delivered by project teams and technology partners.**
* **Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, resilient and fit for long-term business requirements.**

**Master Data Management (MDM)**

* **Demonstrate a strong understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) concepts, principles and implementation approaches.**
* **Identify key master data domains and define appropriate ownership and governance.**
* **Understand master/reference data relationships and dependencies across the enterprise.**
* **Define MDM target-state architecture and roadmap where required.**
* **Support selection and implementation of MDM solutions and processes.**
* **Ensure MDM initiatives are aligned with the wider Data Strategy and Data Governance framework.**

**Asset Historian / Operational Data**

* **Understand asset historian / historian data and its role within an asset-intensive environment.**
* **Understand how operational/industrial asset data is captured, stored, governed and consumed.**
* **Assess the relationship between asset information, historian data, master data and enterprise data.**
* **Define appropriate governance, architecture and integration approaches for historian and asset-related data.**
* **Identify opportunities to improve the accessibility, quality, lineage and value of asset data.**

**Required Experience & Skills**

* **15+ years of overall experience in Data Strategy, Data Architecture, Data Governance, Data Management or large-scale Data Transformation.**
* **Strong experience in Data Strategy development and execution.**
* **Proven experience developing and implementing Data Governance frameworks and operating models.**
* **Strong Solution Architecture / Data Architecture background.**
* **Demonstrable experience translating strategy into projects, programmes and implementation roadmaps.**
* **Experience developing business cases for data and technology initiatives.**
* **Strong understanding of Data Retention, Data Archival and Data Lifecycle Management.**
* **Strong understanding of MDM and Master/Reference Data.**
* **Experience working with asset data / historian environments is highly desirable.**
* **Experience working across business and technology functions to define target-state architecture.**
* **Strong consulting background with proven ability to work with senior stakeholders.**
* **Demonstrable hands-on implementation and delivery experience.**
* **Strong understanding of enterprise integration and modern data architecture patterns.**
* **Experience with Data Governance platforms such as Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Microsoft Purview, Informatica or equivalent is desirable.**
* **Strong programme, portfolio and stakeholder management skills.**
* **Excellent communication, presentation, workshop facilitation and influencing skills.**

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

**The ideal candidate is a senior data leader and strong Solution Architect who can operate across the full lifecycle:**

**Data Strategy → Data Roadmap → Business Cases → Project Portfolio → Architecture → Data Governance → Implementation → Benefits Realisation**

**They should be equally comfortable:**

* **Speaking with C-level and senior business stakeholders about strategy and value.**
* **Defining the enterprise Data Strategy and target operating model.**
* **Designing the Data Architecture and solution approach.**
* **Establishing Data Governance and ownership.**
* **Defining Data Retention and Archival strategies.**
* **Understanding MDM and asset/historian data.**
* **Breaking a high-level strategy into concrete projects and workstreams.**
* **Building business cases and investment propositions for each project.**
* **Providing architectural oversight and guiding delivery teams through implementation.**

**The key requirement is someone who can bridge strategy and execution — a senior architect who can define the vision, create the roadmap, convert the roadmap into funded projects and provide the technical and governance leadership required to deliver them.**

**Key Attributes**

* **15+ years of relevant experience**
* **Strong Solution Architect / Data Architect**
* **Strategic thinker with strong execution capability**
* **Strong Data Governance expertise**
* **Strong Data Strategy and Roadmap experience**
* **Data Retention & Archival knowledge**
* **MDM understanding**
* **Asset / Historian data understanding**
* **Strong business case development capability**
* **Consulting + implementation experience**
* **Excellent senior stakeholder management**
* **Strong analytical and problem-solving skills**
* **Ability to operate across business, data and technology**
* **Available to work onsite**
* **Available to join at short notice / ASAP**
